# External dependency (not part of this repository)

`csccm-iitd_WNO_fa6b5a7/wavelet_convolution_v3.py` — the unmodified file `wavelet_convolution_v3.py` of the official WNO
repository <https://github.com/csccm-iitd/WNO> at commit `fa6b5a79ad97ad5c2f8ee3773fe3c732d344dee3`
(SHA-256 `5b80065afdcf2a24ce1b9e60d946132fa4d7a3da54a285bfa2055d32bac0e3b6`, git blob `9bf0a9426253a8c81bab5342cca7de5fd2c7d8e1`).

Get it with `python -B tools/fetch_wno_upstream.py` (or `--from_file <path>` for a copy you obtained yourself).
The upstream repository declares no license; the file is therefore not distributed here, and this directory is
excluded from version control (`.gitignore`). See `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
